projects.name: Assignment 8 — Multi-Agent Growing-Graph Orchestrator
projects.tagline: This repository contains **Session 8 (S8)** of the EAGV3 course: a multi-agent AI system where a **directed graph of skills** is the agent loop. Each node is a
projects.description: This repository contains **Session 8 (S8)** of the EAGV3 course: a multi-agent AI system where a **directed graph of skills** is the agent loop. Each node is a specialized LLM-backed role (Planner, Researcher, Coder, Formatter, etc.); edges carry typed results between nodes; and the graph **grows at runtime** as skills finish and the orchestrator splices in successors.
highlights: Directed graph of skills is the agent loop
Each node is an LLM-backed role: Planner, Researcher, Coder, Formatter
The graph grows at runtime as skills finish and the orchestrator splices in successors
LLM Gateway V8 is a FastAPI service for chat, routing, and embeddings

diagram.content:
User Query
    │
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  flow.py — Executor                                      │
│  • Builds / resumes a NetworkX DiGraph                   │
│  • Finds "ready" nodes (all predecessors complete)       │
│  • Runs ready nodes in parallel (asyncio.gather)         │
│  • Extends graph after each success                      │
│  • Handles failures via recovery.py                      │

    │
    ├── skills.py — render prompt, call gateway or sandbox

projects.name: EAG Cognitive Agent
projects.tagline: **EAG V3 Session 7** — four-role agentic architecture with **FAISS vector memory** (RAG): **Memory**, **Perception**, **Decision**, and **Action**, orchestrated
projects.description: **EAG V3 Session 7** — four-role agentic architecture with **FAISS vector memory** (RAG): **Memory**, **Perception**, **Decision**, and **Action**, orchestrated in `agent7.py` with eleven MCP tools and **LLM Gateway V7** (`/v1/embed` + chat).
highlights: Perception: plans goals, marks progress, attaches artifact IDs when needed (Gemini `provider=g`).
Decision: sees **one** goal only; answers or calls a single tool.
Action: runs MCP tools; payloads >4KB → content-addressable `art:…` store.
Memory: vector search first (FAISS over embeddings), keyword fallback; `state/memory.json` + index files persist across runs (`c2`, `f2` need prior run state).

diagram.content:
User query
  → memory.remember(query)
  → loop (max 24 iterations):
       memory.read(query, history)
       perception.observe → goal list + done flags
       if all done → break
       decision.next_step(ONE goal) → answer OR one MCP tool
       action.execute → memory.record_outcome (+ artifact if large)
  → final answer from run history
